email.body1:
Ted, saw DCI rolled out Web Push Provisioning for card-issuing banks and opened the 2026 DCI Conference.

New capabilities like that usually mean more in-market community banks and credit unions than your region can personally touch before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for DCI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ted, quick follow-up for DCI.

As new features ship, regional pipeline targets usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ted, last bit of proof for DCI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how DCI's reply rate likely compares to other bank core and fintech providers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ted, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while Web Push Provisioning ramps, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a launch, and I know that stretch keeps a regional team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your community banking motion? I'll tailor it to DCI either way.
